texts.r:skill:e.e1.alpha: Amagama alula ukuwakhumbula xa uwazi isandi sokuqala nonobumba wokuqala. Yithi izandi ngokuvakalayo xa ufunda.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.greet: Xa udibana nomntu, yithi **Hello**. Xa uhamba, yithi **Goodbye**. Yithi igama lakho ngo-**My name is ...**.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.numcol: Funda amagama amanani anje ngo-one, two, three... namagama emibala anje ngo-red, blue, yellow...
texts.r:skill:e.e1.family: mother (mum), father (dad), grandmother (grandma), baby (umntwana omncinci kakhulu): la ngamagama abantu losapho lwakho.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.class: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Yithi izinto zakho zeklasi ngesiNgesi.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.noun: Amagama athiya izinto, anje ngo-rabbit (isilwanyana esinendlebe ezinde), bird (isilwanyana esibhabhayo) no-fish (isilwanyana esiqubayo), abizwa ngokuba zii-**nouns**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.verb: Amagama abonisa isenzo, anje ngo-jump (ukunyuka emoyeni), run (ukuhamba ngokukhawuleza) no-eat (ukuba nokutya), abizwa ngokuba zii-**verbs**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.like: **I like ...** kuthetha ukuba uyayonwabela into. **I have ...** kuthetha ukuba into ngeyakho.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.sent: Emva kwe-I, sebenzisa **am**. Emva kwe-You, sebenzisa **are**. Isivakalisi silandela le odolo: 'ngubani → yintoni okanye wenza ntoni'.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.read: Xa ufunda, qala ufune amagama ombuzo kwisicatshulwa.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.build: Isivakalisi sihamba ngolu cwangco: 'ngubani → wenza → ntoni'. Emva kwe-He, She okanye igama lomntu, yongeza **-s** kwisenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.pron: Endaweni yegama, ungasebenzisa i-**He**, **She**, **It**, **They** okanye i-**We**.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.tense: Kwizinto ezenzeka ngoku okanye ngokuphindaphindiweyo, sebenzisa i-**present**. Kwizinto esele zenzekile, sebenzisa i-**past**: yongeza **-ed** ekupheleni kwesenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.routine: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Thetha ngobomi bakho bemihla ngemihla ngesiNgesi.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.read: Funda umbhalo uze ufumane ukuba ngubani owenze ntoni, nini.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.abc1: Ialfabhethi inooNobumba **abakhulu** nooNobumba **abancinci**. Izibini ezininzi zibonakala zahlukile, ngoko zifunde isibini ngasinye. Phawula ngakumbi oonobumba ababonakala befana, abanjengo-b, d, p no-q.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.snd1: Isandi sokuqala selizwi sinxulunyaniswa nonobumba walo wokuqala. Fumana amagama aqala ngesandi esinye ukuze ufunde ukuba izandi nopelo zinxulumene njani. Ngamanye amaxesha oonobumba ababini, njengo-ph, benza isandi se-f.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.tense: Kwangoku okanye imikhwa, sebenzisa i-**present**. Kwixesha elidlulileyo, yongeza **-ed**. Kwizinto oza kuzenza, sebenzisa i-**will + base verb**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.qneg: Qala umbuzo nge-**Do/Does**. Ukuthi hayi, sebenzisa i-**don't/doesn't**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.adj: Amagama anjengo-big, small, hot kunye ne-cold achaza ukuba into ibonakala okanye iziva injani.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.prep: Sebenzisa i-**on**, **in**, **under** kunye ne-**behind** ukuthi izinto zikuphi.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.read: Fumana ukuba ngubani owenze ntoni, nakuphi, kumbhalo, uze uphendule.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.gram: Sebenzisa i-**an** phambi kwesandi sevawuli kunye ne-**a** phambi kwesandi sesikhamiso. Kwinto enye, sebenzisa i-**There is**. Kwizinto ezininzi, sebenzisa i-**There are**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.comp: Ukuthelekisa izinto ezimbini, sebenzisa i-**-er + than**. Kwi-'the most', sebenzisa i-**the -est**. Kumagama amade, sebenzisa i-**more**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.future: Kwizinto oza kuzenza, sebenzisa i-**will + base verb** okanye i-**be going to + base verb**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.transform: Kwizichasi, sebenzisa i-**not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Kwimibuzo, beka i-**Are / Do / Does** ekuqaleni kwesivakalisi.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.read: Imibhalo emide ilula ukuba ufumana ukuba ngubani, phi, nini kunye noko kwenzekileyo, ngokungathi uyabasika.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.tense: Kwizinto ezenzeka ngoku, sebenzisa i-**be + -ing**. Kwixesha elidlulileyo, sebenzisa i-**past tense**. Kwixesha elizayo, sebenzisa i-**will / be going to**.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.vocab: Funda amagama anentsingiselo efanayo nezichasi kunye, kwaye isigama sakho siza kuphindaphindeka.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.read: Funda umbhalo onezivakalisi ezininzi uze ufumane ukuba ngubani owenze into, nini, kwaye kutheni.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.seq1: Amagama abonisa ucwangco, anjengo-**First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** kunye ne-**Finally**, akuxelela ucwangco apho izinto zenzeke khona.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.pun1: Isivakalisi siqala nge-**nonobumba omkhulu** kwaye siphela ngophawu olufanelekileyo lwe-**mitha**: ichokoza (.) kwingxelo, uphawu lombuzo (?) kumbuzo, kunye nophawu lokukhwaza (!) kwisothuso okanye imvakalelo eyomeleleyo. Amagama abantu negama elithi I zihlala zibhalwa ngonobumba abakhulu.
texts.r:skill:e.vocab: Funda amagama aqhelekileyo ngokudibanisa **isandi + intsingiselo + upelo** kwaye uya kuwakhumbula ixesha elide. Cofa iqhosha lesithethi ukuva ukuba avakala njani.
texts.r:skill:e.be: Isenzo se-be siguquka ngokwesihloko. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
texts.r:skill:e.pres: Xa isihloko sele **he / she / it (umntu wesithathu obodwa)**, yongeza **-s / -es** kwisenzo. Amagama aphela nge-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o athatha -es. Kwi-consonant + y, tshintsha y ibe i uze wongeze -es!
texts.r:skill:e.plural: Kubabini okanye ngaphezulu, ngokuqhelekileyo yongeza **-s** kwibizo. Iibizo eziphela nge-x zithatha **-es**. Funda ngentloko amaninzi angaqhelekanga. Isivakalisi sihamba **isihloko → isenzo → okuseleyo**.
texts.r:skill:e.order: Kubabini okanye ngaphezulu, ngokuqhelekileyo yongeza **-s** kwibizo. Iibizo eziphela nge-x zithatha **-es**. Funda ngentloko amaninzi angaqhelekanga. Isivakalisi sihamba **isihloko → isenzo → okuseleyo**.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.perf: have/has + past participle. Ibonisa amava, ukugqitywa okanye ukuqhubeka. Hlula phakathi kwe-since (ixesha elithile) kunye ne-for (ubude bexesha).
texts.r:skill:e.m2.pass: Sebenzisa be + past participle ukuthi into yenziwa komnye umntu okanye into. Yongeza umenzi nge-by.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.inf: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V ibonisa injongo, kwaye stop + V-ing kuthetha ukuyeka isenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.comp: -er/-est kunye ne-more/most. Sebenzisa than kunye nezithelekisi kunye ne-the kunye nezona. good → better → best ayiqhelekanga.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.read: Funda umbuzo kuqala, uze ufumane isivakalisi esibonisa. Isihloko nombono ophambili ziogoqa lonke umbhalo.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.sum1: Ukushwankathela, fumana **umbono ophambili** uwuncitshise ube sisivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini. Isivakalisi esimalunga nenkcukacha enye kuphela, esongeza into engekho kwisicatshulwa, okanye esibanzi kakhulu asisosishwankathelo esilungileyo.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.rel: Dibanisa izivakalisi ezimbini zibe nye nge-who (abantu), which (izinto), that (zombini) kunye ne-whose (ubunini).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.cond: If + ixesha langoku, will + V (into enokwenzeka). If + ixesha elidlulileyo, would + V (ukucinga into engeyonyani ngoku).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.ques: Sebenzisa ulandelelwano lwegama lombuzo + isihloko + isenzi. Musa ukusebenzisa do/does/did.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.part: -ing iyasebenza okanye iqhubeka; -ed yipassive okanye igqityiwe. Kwiimvakalelo, sebenzisa -ing kwinto ebangela imvakalelo kunye -ed kumntu oyivayo.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.read: Dibanisa izalathisi ukwenza ukuqikelela. Misela injongo yombhalo ngokujonga izicelo neengxoxo zawo.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.tense: had + p.p. yeyento eyenzeke ngaphambi kwenye into edlulileyo. have been -ing yesenzo esiqhubeke kude kube ngoku.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.clause: where / when / why zii-relative ezisebenza njengezihlomelo. whether / that zazisa izivakalisi zesibizo.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.partc: Susa isidibanisi nesihloko uze utshintshe isenzi sibe -ing. Isihloko kufuneka sifane kwiinxalenye zombini.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.conn: Hlula isizathu nesiphumo (so, therefore), umahluko (however), imizekelo (for example) nokongeza (in addition).
texts.r:skill:e.h1.main: Umbono ophambili udla ngokuza emva kwe However, ephendulela inkolelo eqhelekileyo, nakwisivakalisi sokugqibela. Zalisa isithuba ulandela ukuhamba kwengxaki → isisombululo → isiphumo.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.inv: Xa Never/Hardly/Only then iqala kuqala, ulandelelwano lube sisenzi esincedisayo + isihloko. Sebenzisa It is ~ that ekugxininiseni.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.subj: Kwiziqendu ze-I wish / as if / If, sebenzisa ixesha elidlulileyo kokuchasene nangoku kwaye had p.p. kokuchasene nokwedlulileyo.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.wh: whatever, whoever, whichever kunye however + isichazi zithetha 'nokuba yintoni / ngubani / leliphi / kangakanani ...'.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.vocab: Qikelela intsingiselo yegama elitsha ngezalathisi zomahluko, umzekelo nesizathu, nakwisimaphambili saso.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.logic: Landela umbhalo usebenzisa oko amagama okukhomba akubhekisele kuko namagama adibanisayo. Qokelela iinkcukacha ukuze ufikelele kwisiphelo.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.par: Amabinzana adityaniswe nge-and/but/or athatha imo efanayo. Isenzi sivumelana nesihloko esiphambili.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.tone: Fumana umoya ngamagama achazayo neemvakalelo. Fumana injongo ngokujonga ukuba umbhalo ucela, uyazisa okanye uyakholisa.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.ins: Sebenzisa amagama adibanisayo, amagama okukhomba nolandelelwano lwexesha njengezalathisi zokulungelelanisa izivakalisi nokufumana apho isivakalisi esinikiweyo sifanelana khona.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.col: Funda izibini zamagama ezihamba kunye, njenge make a decision, take a risk ne heavy rain. Qikelela intsingiselo yamabinzana ngemeko.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.sum: Fumana umbono ophambili namabinzana okuchasa kumbhalo uze uwabophe kwisivakalisi esinye.
texts.r:skill:e.h.conv: Kwimibuzo yencoko, jonga hayi kuphela ukuba igrama ichanekile kodwa nokuba ithoni ivakala ngendlela yendalo nethobekileyo kuloo meko. Izicelo, ukunqanda intetho, ukuphendula iinkcazo, amabinzana kunye nentetho engathanga ngqo zivela rhoqo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.job: KwisiNgesi somsebenzi, amanqaku aphambili ngamabinzana (touch base), izifinyezo (ASAP, njl.) nezibini zesenzi nesihlomelo sendawo (collocation). Musa ukuguqulela igama nigama; khumbula njengamaqela asetyenziswa kwiimeko zomsebenzi.
texts.r:skill:e.h.media: KwisiNgesi seemidiya, kubalulekile ukwahlula iinyani kwizimvo nokugweba ukuba ingqiqo yengxoxo iluqilima na. Khumbula amagama anjengeenkcazo zemifanekiso (alt text, caption) neengxowa zokuhlela ngenjongo yazo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.world: Kwizihloko zenkcubeko yehlabathi, funda amagama aphambili anjengo culture, diversity ne stereotype, namabinzana okuzama ukuqonda ezinye iinkcubeko ngaphandle kokuzigweba. Hlula amagama afanayo usebenzisa izalathisi zomxholo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.lit: Kwimibuzo yoncwadi, into ephambili kukwazi inkcazo yegama uze uyisebenzise kumboniso webali. Gcina foreshadowing, symbol, point of view, theme kunye needima zabalinganiswa zahlukile.
texts.r:skill:e.h.debate: Idebate ifuna ukwahlula amagama (motion, rebuttal, njl.), iindidi zobungqina neempazamo zengqiqo. Xa uvavanya ingxoxo, qala ubuze, "Bubuphi ubungqina balo?"
texts.r:skill:e.h.write: Ekubhaleni, khetha uhlobo olufanelekileyo injongo nomfundi, kwaye jonga amalungu esivakalisi (isihloko nesenzi) kunye nengqiqo yamagama adibanisayo. Kwimibhalo ethile njengeresume, izenzo namanani kungcono kunamagama angacacanga.

texts.q:eb-e6a4c5e4-q5: UNoah uza kwenza ntoni xa efika kwithala leencwadi?
texts.q:eb-ebbd834d-q3: Kutheni abanye abantu besenza inkqubela encinci phesheya?
texts.q:eb-ec76448b-q1: UTata ucela u-Ari ukuba ahlambe ntoni?
texts.q:eb-f0e93a02-q2: Kutheni ikati encinci ifuthela ngelixa isela ubisi?
texts.q:eb-f1232ce3-q3: Kutheni imaphu yesitimela esingaphantsi komhlaba ibonisa imigama elinganayo phakathi kwezitishi?
texts.q:eb-f1a379cf-q3: Benza ntoni abantu abafuna ukugqibelela rhoqo?
texts.q:eb-f219e2c5-q3: I-'those' kwi-'than those on ordinary land' ibhekisa kuyintoni?
texts.q:eb-f219e2c5-q4: Sesiphi esichaza isimo sengqondo sombhali ngokukhetha kwabalimi?
texts.q:eb-f5596fd9-q3: Ngokombhalo, yintoni ekuthi ukuhlala wedwa okukhethiweyo kuyizise?
texts.q:eb-f6d8c54f-q2: Yivakalelwa njani intombazana xa yayiqala ukuma?
texts.q:eb-f9a4f6ec-q4: Yivakalelwa njani iqela lombhali ngoko nangoko emva komdlalo?
texts.q:eb-fb23fddd-q2: Ngokombhalo, ngubani onokuthi azi igama lakho eligqithisileyo?
texts.q:eb-fb23fddd-q4: Yintoni ekufuneka uyenze ukuba umntu ongamaziyo uthumela umyalezo?
texts.q:eb-fdb1067f-q4: Ngubani ofanele atyikitye ikhadi lethala leencwadi?
texts.q:eb-ff5b1737-q3: Yenza ntoni intsapho ngoko nangoko emva kokubona amathambo e-dinosaur?
texts.w:~인지 아닌지: ukuba; kusetyenziswa xa kuthethwa ngokhetho oluzimbini
texts.w:가구: izinto ezinje ngezitulo, iitafile namabhedi ekhaya
texts.w:가설: ingcamango ekufuneka ivavanywe ukuze kubonwe ukuba iyinyani
texts.w:가정하다, 추정하다: ukucinga ukuba into iyinyani ngaphandle kobungqina
texts.w:감사하다: ukuxelela umntu ukuba wonwabile ngoncedo lwakhe
texts.w:검사하다: ukujonga into ngocoselelo ukuze ufumane iimpazamo
texts.w:결국에는: emva kokuba kudlule ixesha elininzi; ekugqibeleni
texts.w:경험: into oyifunda ngokwenza okanye ngokubona izinto
texts.w:균형을 잡다: ukufumana indawo ephakathi elungileyo phakathi kweento ezimbini
texts.w:그래도, 개의치 않고: nangona kukho iingxaki okanye oko abanye bakucinga
texts.w:그릇: isitya esijikelezileyo sesuphu okanye sokutya okusanqatyiswa
texts.w:기념식: isiganeko esikhethekileyo sokuhlonipha umntu okanye usuku
texts.w:긴: enobude obukhulu ukusuka esiphelweni ukuya kwesinye
texts.w:긴장한: unexhala okanye uyoyika kancinci ngokuza kwenzeka
texts.w:닭: intaka etshisa amaqanda yaye ikhuliswa ukuze ityiwe
texts.w:대문자의: obhalwe ngohlobo olukhulu, njengo-A okanye B
texts.w:돼지: isilwanyana sasefama esimdaka ngombala wepinki esenza isandi se-oink
texts.w:모음: isandi esenziwa ngaphandle kokuvala umlomo, njengo a, e, i, o, u
texts.w:모퉁이: indawo apho izitrato ezimbini okanye iindonga zidibana khona
texts.w:무지개: imibala emininzi ebonwa esibhakabhakeni emva kwesaqhwithi
texts.w:박물관: indawo egcina iyabonisa izinto ezindala okanye ezikhethekileyo
texts.w:방문하다: ukuya uchithe ixesha kwindawo okanye komnye umntu
texts.w:방향: indlela eya kuyo into okanye umntu
texts.w:배: inqanawa enkulu ethwala abantu okanye impahla
texts.w:복숭아: isiqhamo esimnandi, esithambileyo, esijikelezileyo, esinolusu olunoboya
texts.w:비교하다: ukujonga ukuba izinto ziyafana okanye ziyahluka
texts.w:사촌: umntwana wodade okanye wabhuti wabazali bakho
texts.w:색깔: into eyenza ibomvu, eblowu okanye eluhlaza zahluke
texts.w:서먹함을 깨다: ukwenza abantu bakhululeke xa bedibana okokuqala
texts.w:선례를 남기다: ukwenza into abanye abaza kuyilinganisa kamva
texts.w:설문 조사를 하다: ukubuza abantu abaninzi imibuzo ukuze ufunde iinkolelo zabo
texts.w:순서: indlela izinto ezilandelana ngayo enye emva kwenye
texts.w:승객: umntu ukhwele ibhasi, uloliwe okanye inqwelomoya
texts.w:시작부터 잘 해내다: ukwenza kakuhle kakhulu ukususela osukwini lokuqala
texts.w:아래쪽에: ukudlula into uze uye ngaphaya kwayo
texts.w:아주 흥미로운: enomdla kangangokuba ungakwazi ukujonga kwenye indawo
texts.w:약화시키다: ukwenza into ibe buthathaka, kancinci kancinci
texts.w:여행: uhambo olude ukusuka kwenye indawo ukuya kwenye
texts.w:열다: ukuhambisa ucango okanye isiciko ukuze singavaliwe
texts.w:열쇠: isixhobo sentsimbi esivula ibhokisi okanye ingcango
texts.w:오염: ukungcola emoyeni, emanzini okanye emhlabeni okubenzakalisayo
texts.w:완화하다: ukwenza into ingabi namandla okanye ibe mbi kangako
texts.w:우선순위: into ebaluleke kakhulu ekufuneka yenziwe kuqala

texts.w:읽다: ukujonga amagama uze uwathethe okanye uwazi
texts.w:자: isixhobo esicabileyo sokuzoba imigca ethe ngqo
texts.w:자원: into abantu abanokuyisebenzisa, njengamanzi okanye ioli
texts.w:장려책: umvuzo owenza abantu bafune ukwenza ngakumbi
texts.w:재활용하다: ukusebenzisa kwakhona izinto ezindala ukwenza ezintsha
texts.w:잼: ukutya okumnandi okwenziwe ngesiqhamo, okubekwa esonkeni
texts.w:전통: inkolelo okanye isiqhelo esidluliselwe iminyaka emininzi
texts.w:절차를 생략하다: ukwenza umsebenzi kakubi ukonga ixesha okanye imali
texts.w:조건: imeko yezinto; into kufuneka yenzeke kuqala
texts.w:종이: amaphepha amancinci obhala okanye uzoba kuwo

texts.w:즉흥적으로 하다: ukugqiba into oza kuyenza njengoko izinto zenzeka
texts.w:짠: okunencasa yamanzi olwandle okanye ukongwa kakhulu
texts.w:철자를 말하다: ukuthetha okanye ukubhala oonobumba begama ngolandelelwano
texts.w:치열한 경쟁: ulwaphulo olunzima lokuphumelela indawo okanye ibhaso
texts.w:칠판: umphezulu ocabileyo egumbini lokufundela wokubhala kuwo
texts.w:키가 큰: ude; onomzimba omde ukusuka ezantsi ukuya phezulu
texts.w:통과해서: ukungena kwelinye icala kwaye uphume kwelinye
texts.w:평판: oko abantu bakucinga ngomntu okanye ngento
texts.w:한 쌍: izinto ezimbini zohlobo olufanayo ezihamba kunye
texts.w:희생: ukuyeka into exabisekileyo ngenxa yesinye isizathu
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q1: UMina uthe, "Amaqela amathathu sele ewukhethile lo," ngoko uMina uyawala kuba amanye amaqela sele ekhethe esi sihloko esifanayo.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q2: UMina uthi iijaji zinokudikwa kwaye ukhetha isihloko "esingaqhelekanga kakhulu", ngoko sinokuqonda ukuba uMina ufuna iprojekthi ebonakalayo.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q3: Ukuthi isihluzi samanzi "asiqhelekanga" kunentaba-mlilo kuthetha ukuba asiqhelekanga.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q4: Emva kokuba ingcamango yentaba-mlilo yaliwe, uJoon wathetha oku ukucebisa enye indlela.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q5: Ekugqibeleni uMina wathi, "Ndiza kwenza uluhlu ngokuhlwa kwanamhlanje."
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q1: U-Abel wathi, "Sinye nesinye sinamashumi amabini eedola kuphela." Amashumi amabini eedola yimali abanayo bonke kunye.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q2: UJun ebesenza iiresiphi ezintsha, ngoko unokubona ukuba uJun unomdla wokupheka.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q3: Kuthetha ukuba incwadi yokupheka sisipho esihle esibonisa ukuba bacinge ngoJun.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q4: ULena uthetha oku ukubonisa ukuba kunye banamashumi amabini eedola, ayaneleyo ukuthenga incwadi ebiza ishumi elinesibhozo.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q5: Ekugqibeleni uLena wathi, "Kuqala ndiza kujonga iiyure zevenkile."
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q1: UJisu wathi ingca emanzi ayonwabisi kwaye amasanwishi aza kuthamba.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q2: UBen uthi, "Ndiza kufowuna ndiyibhukishe namhlanje," ngoko unokubona ukuba igumbi kufuneka libhukishwe kuqala.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q3: Oku kuthethwa ekuphenduleni isizathu sikaJisu, ngaphambi kokunika enye indlela, ngoko "Fair enough" kuthetha ukwamkela inqaku lomnye umntu.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q4: "No way" yintetho eveza ukuchasa ngokuqinileyo ingcebiso yokurhoxisa.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q5: UBen wathi, "Ndiza kufowuna ndiyibhukishe namhlanje." Ukwazisa abanye ngumsebenzi kaJisu.
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q3: UJun waxelela uSora ukuba azise nje ibhotile yamanzi. Ikayiti sele ilungiselelwe uSora.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q1: Umabhalana wathi "clean water every week." Kabini ngemini yile ndlela intlanzi ityetyiswa ngayo.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q2: USora uyalila ukuba itanki ngumsebenzi omkhulu kwaye uthi uza kuqala ngentlanzi yabaqalayo, ngoko unokuqonda ukuba uSora akazange agcine iintlanzi ngaphambili.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q3: Kwimeko leyo, intlanzi yegolide ilungele abantu abagcina iintlanzi okokuqala, ngoko "beginners" kuthetha abantu abasandula ukuqala.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q4: Ngokubuza ukuba intlanzi ifuna ukuhoywa kangaphi, uSora ufuna ukwazi ukuba ngumsebenzi omkhulu kangakanani.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q2: Ukupakisha ikhoti yemvula "just in case" kubonisa ukuba uNoah ucinga ukuba kunokuna imvula kodwa akaqinisekanga.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q3: Kwimeko leyo, ukuba imvula ikhulu uya kuba "soaked," okuthetha ukumanzi kakhulu.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q4: "If I were you" libinzana elisetyenziselwa ukunika umntu icebiso.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q5: U-Ella wacela, "Text me when you arrive," ngoko u-Noah usenokumthumelela umyalezo u-Ella xa efika apho.
